decisions.reason: The electronic music box is a newer, less core item for a traditional Erzgebirge-style wood crafts firm, but it is still on the website after only one season and cost has been sunk into it, so management will likely give it more time and blame weak results on the short selling period.
A wooden nativity stable fits the firm's core Christmas woodcraft identity and builds on its existing skills and channels, so management is strongly committed and unlikely to withdraw it.

The modern incense smoker carries forward the firm's traditional product line and signals the announced move toward contemporary designs, so management will persist and treat any weak first-season sales as temporary.
